name: probanda
description: Probanda, Claude Cowork plugins for legal practice in British Columbia

plugins.name: legal
plugins.description: The core plugin: firm records, time, billing, case data and deadlines. Requires nothing. Install it first: every other Probanda plugin except lawyer requires it.

plugins.name: researcher
plugins.description: What the law is: legal research, citation and verification. Requires legal. Install legal first, then researcher.

plugins.name: litigator
plugins.description: Court work on a matter: applying the law to the facts, drafting, court forms and filing packages. Requires legal and researcher. Install legal, then researcher, then litigator.

plugins.name: solicitor
plugins.description: Reserved for solicitor's work. Ships no skills yet. Requires legal. Install legal first.

plugins.name: lawyer
plugins.description: Skills for any lawyer: restate a request before acting, and summarize a session. Requires nothing.

plugins.name: file-manager
plugins.description: Optional. Every Probanda tool that renames, moves, changes or deletes files on your computer that Probanda did not create: matter housekeeping, routing accounting files, applying approved renames. Without it, Probanda only reads or copies those files. Requires legal. Install legal first, then file-manager.

plugins.name: timekeeper
plugins.description: Optional. Automated time tracking: gathers the evidence of a day's work, sorts it to client matters, corrects TimeCamp and drafts time entries. Billing stays in legal. Requires legal. Install legal first, then timekeeper.
